explanation: Two rank-one updates at layer 10 steer residual writes toward the mean plain-question state, using contrasts averaged over both correct and wrong suggestions to avoid a simple contradiction direction. The updates use existing writer features and account for post-writer RMSNorm scales. No gradients or training were used. Final strength 3 is an unscored interpolation between feedback-tested strengths 2 and 4, chosen to balance wrong-guess correction against plain and correct-guess accuracy; the feedback did not establish a complete solution.
